samf-junior-2018-r2-01.prompt: What is the last digit of $2018\times8012$?

samf-junior-2018-r2-03.prompt: If $100\div5=4\times A$ then find the value of $A$.

samf-junior-2018-r2-05.prompt: $ABCD$ is a square with area $72\text{ cm}^2$. $ABCD$ is split into $9$ identical squares. What is the shaded area in $\text{cm}^2$?

samf-junior-2018-r2-06.prompt: The diagram shows kite $ABCD$. What is the size of $\angle ABC$ in degrees?

samf-junior-2018-r2-07.prompt: The solid shown was made by gluing together four identical cubes each with side length $1$ cm. What is the total surface area of the solid in $\text{cm}^2$?

samf-junior-2018-r2-08.prompt: The sum of four consecutive whole numbers is $2018$. Find the smallest of these numbers.

samf-junior-2018-r2-09.prompt: In the expression $W\times X^Y-Z$, the values of $W$, $X$, $Y$ and $Z$ are $2$, $0$, $1$ and $8$, but not necessarily in that order. What is the maximum possible value of $W\times X^Y-Z$?

samf-junior-2018-r2-10.prompt: Sanjeev gets the disease algebritis and must take one green pill and one pink pill each day for three weeks. A green pill costs R1 more than a pink pill. Sanjeev's pills cost R2121 for the three weeks. How many rands does a green pill cost?

samf-junior-2018-r2-11.prompt: How many $2$-digit odd numbers can be made using the digits $1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8$ if each digit can be used only once in a given number?

samf-junior-2018-r2-12.prompt: The six angles of two different triangles are listed from largest to smallest. The two smallest angles have been left off the list: $120^\circ,80^\circ,65^\circ,37^\circ,\_\_\_,\_\_\_$. In degrees, what is the last angle on the list?

samf-junior-2018-r2-13.prompt: The vertices of a $3$-$4$-$5$ right-angled triangle $ABC$ are the centres of three circles that just touch each other. If $AB=3$ cm, $AC=4$ cm and $BC=5$ cm, determine the sum of the diameters of the three circles in cm.

samf-junior-2018-r2-14.prompt: Skylar is sewing together a rectangular quilt. The quilt is $1{,}5$ metres long and $1{,}2$ metres wide, and is made from square pieces of fabric each measuring $15$ cm by $15$ cm. At every point where four squares meet, Skylar plans to sew on a bright button. How many buttons will be needed?

samf-junior-2018-r2-15.prompt:
In the sum below, each letter represents a different digit. $ABC$ and $BCC$ are $3$-digit numbers. What is the digit $A$?
$$\begin{array}{cccc}&A&B&C\\+&A&B&C\\\hline&B&C&C\end{array}$$

samf-junior-2018-r2-16.prompt: The average of $v$ and $w$ is $200$. The average of $x$, $y$ and $z$ is $150$. Determine the average of $v$, $w$, $x$, $y$ and $z$.

samf-junior-2018-r2-17.prompt: Some numbers, when divided by $4$, leave a remainder of $3$; when divided by $3$, leave a remainder of $2$; and when divided by $2$, leave a remainder of $1$. Determine the smallest such number.

samf-junior-2018-r2-18.prompt: The diagram shown contains $41$ identical squares. Some of the squares have been shaded. What is the least number of squares that still need to be shaded for the diagram to have a line of symmetry?

samf-junior-2018-r2-19.prompt: Let $\bigstar(x)$ be the sum of the digits of the positive whole number $x$. For example, $\bigstar(8)=8$ and $\bigstar(123)=1+2+3=6$. For how many different $2$-digit numbers $x$ is $\bigstar(\bigstar(x))=3$?

samf-junior-2018-r2-20.prompt: The diagram shows two overlapping circles, $A$ and $B$. The shaded area is $65\text{ m}^2$ while the overlapping area is $15\text{ m}^2$. The ratio of the area of circle $A$ to the area of circle $B$ is $3:2$. By how many $\text{m}^2$ is circle $A$ larger than circle $B$?

samf-junior-2018-r2-21.prompt: The diagram shows a rectangle inside a semicircle. The rectangle just touches the sides of the semicircle. Two lengths are shown. Determine the area of the rectangle in $\text{cm}^2$.

samf-junior-2018-r2-22.prompt: Determine the sum of all integers $x$ which satisfy the equation $(218-x)^{221+x}=1$.

samf-junior-2018-r2-23.prompt: Tom was jogging at a constant speed of $10$ km/h along a straight road. Jerry, jogging at a constant speed of $12$ km/h, is $600$ m behind Tom. How many minutes will it take Jerry to catch up with Tom?

samf-junior-2018-r2-24.prompt: This clock works correctly but the numbers are missing and the clock has been rotated. Use the positions of the hour and minute hands to determine which hour is represented by the letter $A$.
samf-junior-2018-r2-24.reviewNote: Answer taken from the official key; the picture of the rotated clock could not be fully checked independently.

samf-junior-2018-r2-25.prompt: A $10\text{ cm}\times6\text{ cm}$ rectangle is divided into five smaller rectangles of $2\text{ cm}\times6\text{ cm}$. Diagonal $AB$ is drawn, as well as a number of smaller diagonals. How much larger, in $\text{cm}^2$, is the shaded area than the unshaded area?
